pattern.description: After the 'Create a Bundle' nav click, the product cards slide from a two-card row into a left column, the page header and section label fade in above them, and a Bundle summary panel slides in from the right with its line items filling in one after another.
pattern.why_premium: The UI re-lays out in one continuous move instead of a page cut, so the viewer tracks the same Marketing/Sales Hub cards into the new context; staggered line items make the bundle feel assembled in real time.

build_hint.gsap: Use Flip: const s = Flip.getState('.hub-card'); apply bundle layout; Flip.from(s, {duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); then tl.from(['.page-title', '.page-sub', '.section-label'], {opacity: 0, y: 12, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.05}, '<0.05').fromTo('.bundle-panel', {xPercent: 110}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<').from('.bundle-item', {opacity: 0, y: -8, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.07}, '-=0.15'). Nav highlight swaps instantly (set).
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate each card's x/y between the old and new layout rects with Easing.bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) over ~10 frames; header items opacity/translateY with a short ease-out, staggered 1-2 frames; bundle panel translateX via spring({fps, frame, config: {damping: 28, stiffness: 200}}) (no overshoot); line items spring with delay 2 frames each.

notes: Several sub-moves overlap within ~0.4 s, so per-element timing is hard to separate visually. Card start positions are partly off-frame at f1383-f1388. Camera verdict is none; pan values reflect the in-frame reflow.
